header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ فَاَحْسَنََ الْوُضُوْءَ، وَعَادَ اَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ مُحْتَسِبًا، بُوْعِدَ مِنْ جَهَنَّمَ مَسِيْرَةَ سَبْعِيْنَ خَرِيْفًا، قُلْتُ: يَا اَبَا حَمْزَةَ! وَمَا الْخَرِيْفُ؟ قَالَ: الْعَامُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في فضل العيادة علي وضوء رقم:٣٠٩٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas (RA) has narrated that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Whoever performs Wudu in a good manner and goes to visit his sick Muslim brother hoping for good and reward, he will be removed a distance of seventy kharif from Jahannam.” Hazrat Thabit Bunani (RH) says: I asked Hazrat Anas (RA), “O Abu Hamzah! What is kharif?” He replied, “A year is called “kharif”” (he will be removed from Hellfire by a distance of seventy years).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: اَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ يَعُوْدُ مَرِيْضًا فَاِنّمَا يَخُوْضُ فِي الرَّحْمَةِ، فَاِذَا قَعَدَ عِنْدَ الْمَرِيْضِ غَمَرَتْهُ الرَّحْمَةُ، قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ: يَارَسُوْلَ اللهِ! هذَا لِلصَّحِيْحِ الَّذِيْ يَعُوْدُ الْمَرِيْضَ فَالْمَرِيْضُ مَالَهُ؟ قَالَ: تُحَطُّ عَنْهُ ذُنُوْبُهُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: When Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Whoever goes to visit a sick person plunges into a flood of mercy. When he sits near the sick person, rahmah covers him,” I asked, “O Rasulullah! This virtue you have mentioned is for the healthy person who visits the sick. What will the sick person get?” The Prophet ﷺ replied, “His sins are forgiven.” Hazrat Anas ibn
